note: Set A covers the same core callouts as B and additionally captures the fastener specification (common wood nails or screws) and the bolt's diameter and length, which B omits. However, A pads its set with many restatements of the same callouts (bolt stated four ways, deck surface/reclaimed wood surface under two names, plywood deck three ways) and one clearly wrong claim binding a scale-bar tick '1/2"' to a deck module connection dimension. B's four claims are all correct and cleanly quoted, but it drops the fastener type, an important fact on the page. On balance A captures more correct engineering content despite its redundancy and one bad claim.
remarks: Both sets omit the 2" X 8" JOIST callout shown in the B1 detail and the C3 key. A's '1/2"' claim comes from the graphic scale bar under detail B1 (0, 1/2", 1", 1 1/2'), not from any component dimension. A also splits the same callouts into thickness/width/dimensions/size variants, which inflates the claim count without adding facts.
